instruction: Update the background color to white instead of orange to achieve a more minimal look.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the background layer color from orange to white in GIMP. The evaluator exports the image and checks if the background color is white (RGB: 255, 255, 255) with a tolerance of 30 to account for compression artifacts. The custom getter extracts the dominant background color by averaging bright pixels (non-text areas), and the metric compares it against the expected white color using Euclidean distance in RGB space.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement (background color changed to white)
Getter logic is sound: exports image via postconfig, extracts background color by averaging bright pixels (grayscale >= 128)
Metric logic is correct: compares RGB color using Euclidean distance with tolerance of 30
Metric properly handles expected parameter (expected.get('color') correctly accesses the color from rules dict)
Expected value is semantically correct: [255, 255, 255] represents white
Postconfig appropriately exports the GIMP image to PNG for verification
Coverage is complete: single requirement (white background) is fully verified
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The brightness threshold of 128 for identifying background pixels is a reasonable heuristic but may not capture all background areas if the image has darker content. Consider adaptive threshold or region-based analysis for more robust background detection.
